intro: The Hillsbrad Town Registry is an official municipal ledger kept inside the town hall of the Hillsbrad Fields. It serves as an accounting of the settlement's surviving citizens, landowners, and civic records, making it a key strategic target during the Forsaken offensive against the human stronghold.

p: Resting in the town hall near the podium of Magistrate Burnside, the Hillsbrad Town Registry documents the population, households, and administrative rights of Hillsbrad. As the Forsaken from Tarren Mill push to break human resistance in the foothills, Darthalia commands Horde champions to infiltrate the town hall, eliminate the council, and seize this ledger. Confiscating the registry strips Hillsbrad of its civic order and provides the Undercity with valuable intelligence on the surviving population and their assets.
